the ALS iteration for the rank $r $ QCP approximation of the quantization error is exponentially fast in $r $ and that the rank $r \leq 2^k $ QCP interpolation of a function discretized at $O( 2rL) $ grid points is exponentially accurate in $k $, where $k $ is the number of quantization bits per entry.
the QCP representation of a function generated vector is a powerful alternative of the QTT representation.
the rank $r\leq 2$ CP approximation of quantized images of discretized functions can be computed with a high accuracy using only $O(2^2L)\ll 2^2L$ parameters.

the QCP approximation and interpolation methods for the function related data, which are based on the ALS scheme for the CP approximation of quantized vectors.
